display_long_description:
Make bedtime better

Going to bed can be an unwelcome, boring, lonely and anxiety producing moment in our daily lives.

Let bigspoon (formerly Sleep Haven) transport you from your busy daytime wakefulness to a place of serene sleepfulness.

So you can sleep better, longer and get all the benefits that come from getting the amount of sleep your body and mind need to operate at their best.

You can:
Choose your bedtime environment
Choose your bedtime partner should you wish (AI or Meta Quest friend)
Control the weather outside
Control the lighting inside (including blue light)
Control the sounds around you

Your bedtime partner can physically be anywhere in the real world and are able to select their own ideal environment while you both share the same blankets in the virtual world.

We aim to continuously enhance your bigspoon experience and you’ll see many improvements over time including new environments.
